summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K disclosing the conclusion of a tranche of its share repurchase programme. Under the programme initiated 4 February 2026, the company repurchased 14,759,179 B shares for DKK 3.8 billion at an average price of DKK 257.47 per share, representing 0.7% of share capital. The programme is part of an overall up-to-DKK 15 billion buyback over 12 months. No advisor or board recommendation is mentioned. The repurchase is an open-market buyback under EU Safe Harbour Rules, with no fixed price or premium. Watch for continued execution of the remaining DKK 11.2 billion authorization in future tranches.
